generation.path: EvidenceExtractor emits ScoredEvidence; ResearchTools.record_page persists each non-duplicate evidence item, deduplicates Claims by run_id + question_id + whitespace/casefold claim_fingerprint, and creates ResearchClaimRow.
generation.semantic_scope: Claim row is materialized at evidence persistence, including rejected evidence; accepted graph status is computed separately.

claim_id.stable: UUID database identity within persisted run data; stable hash lookup deduplicates same normalized lexical text within run/question.
claim_id.not_equivalent_to: semantic identity across paraphrases, runs, time/version/scope qualifiers, or numeric unit conversions

canonical_text.finding: atomic_claim retains extracted text. claim_hash collapses whitespace and case but does not establish semantic canonicality. No explicit qualifier structure exists in ResearchClaimRow.

claim_evidence_link.finding: research_evidence.claim_id is a nullable FK; evidence row also stores relation, accepted, claim text, exact_quote, source_id, optional snapshot_id/chunk_id. It is effectively a one-evidence-to-one-claim edge, not a first-class many-to-many link.

claim_source_identity.finding: Evidence links to research_sources by source_id. research_sources stores source_owner_key, canonical_url, domain and source_type. Owner sets are derived by joining accepted evidence to source rows.

claim_verification.finding: ClaimVerificationAnalyzer consumes GapRequirement verification_status and aggregate evidence/alignment facts; claim_id is an optional label. It does not persist a per-claim verification result from exact claim-evidence-owner links.

legacy_claim_status.meaning: Evidence graph status. supported requires accepted evidence with at least two distinct source_owner_key values; disputed is set for refuting evidence or deterministic contradiction graph cases. Neither status is equivalent to V2 VERIFIED.

claim_relations.finding: research_claim_edges stores deterministic text relation values supports/supplements/contradicts; research_conflicts stores evidence-pair conflicts. Claim-to-Claim taxonomy is heuristic and does not preserve semantic qualifiers as structured scope.

dimension_vs_claim_verification.finding: GapRequirement is keyed by question/dimension/requirement and owns verification_status; Claim graph is keyed by run/question/claim_hash. Closure/evidence-quality analysis aggregates dimension facts. Dimension closure does not establish a particular Claim VERIFIED.

historical_verified_claims_zero.finding: The current schema has no claim_verification_results table/column or canonical VERIFIED claim status. Historical verified_claims snapshots therefore cannot be reconstructed as per-claim verdicts; zero is not a defensible count. The V1 qualification scorecard explicitly says this field is informational.

migration.reason: Existing V1.1 tables already persist Claim identity, evidence-to-claim FK, exact quote/source/chunk provenance, source_owner_key, relations and conflicts. V2.0 is contract/baseline/diagnostics only; adding columns or writes would be unnecessary runtime schema change.
migration.future_gap: A future many-to-many claim_evidence_links plus versioned claim_verification_results may be warranted after V2.1/V2.2 contracts are exercised; do not backfill or migrate in V2.0.

historical_data_access.persisted_run_database: read-only reachable through the local port-forward using 127.0.0.1:5432; the configured Docker hostname `postgres` itself is not resolvable from this process
historical_data_access.claim_level_rows: reconstructed read-only for the ten Phase 17 qualification runs by scripts/analyze_v2_0_claim_baseline.py
